Somehow or another, Miku and I find ourselves in the storage shed once again.

lines.zh: 我说「不知怎么的」，其实是指我们是来这儿做大扫除的。

lines.en: Being miles ahead of the rest of the team (With the one other exception being Karin), it’s okay for Miku to miss out on practice every once in a while.
lines.zh: Miku 的水平遥遥领先于队里其他人（唯一的例外是 Karin），所以偶尔缺一次训练也没什么。

lines.en: The only issue is that the atmosphere is a little strange given exactly what went down the last time Miku and I were here together.

lines.en: scene mikushed29
: Sorry for sittin’ on top of ya before, Sensei. Had no idea your muscles were so...bleh.
lines.zh: : 老师，刚才坐你身上真不好意思。没想到你的肌肉这么……呃。

lines.en: : Even if I’m little-boy sized, it probably put more unnecessary strain on your body.
lines.zh: : 就算我只有小男孩那么点大，大概还是给你的身体添了不少没必要的负担。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta take care of yourself, ya know? What good will you do any of us if ‘ya wind up gettin’ paralyzed and can’t leave the house anymore?
lines.zh: : 你得照顾好自己啊，知道吗？要是你哪天瘫痪了、连门都出不了，对我们还能有什么用？

lines.en: : I’m not sure how going without shoulder massages could cause paralysis, but I’ll try to keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我不确定不做肩部按摩怎么会让人瘫痪，不过我会记住的。

lines.en: : Good!
lines.zh: : 很好！

lines.en: : Also, please don’t tell Makoto about this cause I’m pretty sure she’ll chop my head off even if this is just a wholesome shoulder rub.
lines.zh: : 还有，千万别告诉 Makoto 这件事，我敢肯定就算这只是次纯洁的肩部按摩，她也会把我的头砍下来。

lines.en: : I think she likes you, Sensei. Like, {i}likes you{/i} likes you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她喜欢你，老师。就是{i}喜欢你{/i}的那种喜欢。

lines.en: : Wow, I wonder what gave you that idea.
lines.zh: : 哇，真不知道你是怎么看出来的。

lines.en: scene mikushed30
: Did you know she keeps a picture of you in her wallet?
lines.zh: : 你知道她钱包里放着你的照片吗？

lines.en: : I saw it the other day when I was goin’ through her bag lookin’ for some spare change to buy a drink with.
lines.zh: : 前几天我翻她包找零钱买饮料的时候看到的。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t be snooping through other peoples’ things, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你不该乱翻别人的东西，Miku。

lines.en: : Probs shouldn’t be giving my teacher a massage either but here I am.
lines.zh: : 大概也不该给自己的老师按摩，可我不还是在这儿按了嘛。

lines.en: : Yup. Here you are.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你确实在这儿。

lines.en: : I’ll remember this when it comes time for me to cash in on the thigh-rubbing I was promised when I agreed to fill the coaching job.
lines.zh: : 等我兑现当初答应接下教练工作时说好的揉大腿福利，我会记得这回事的。

lines.en: scene mikushed31
: Go rub one of the Kanda girls if you want thighs on-demand. I’m fine with just doin’ things like this for now.
lines.zh: : 你要是想要随叫随到的大腿，去揉 Kanda 家的姑娘吧。我现在这样就好。

lines.en: : I can’t be lettin’ things get any weirder between us when my best friend is literally walkin’ around with a mini-Sensei in her wallet.
lines.zh: : 我最好的朋友钱包里可是揣着个迷你老师到处走，我可不能再让我们之间变得更奇怪了。

lines.en: scene black
The pressure Miku applies to my shoulders eases up just seconds after she says that.
lines.zh: 她说完这话没过几秒，按在我肩膀上的力道就轻了下来。

lines.en: One minute later, the massage comes to an end and she proceeds to sit there with her hands on my back until we both get up at exactly the same time and start tossing all of the balls we collected into a bin.
lines.zh: 一分钟后按摩结束，她就这么把手搭在我背上坐着，直到我们俩同时站起身，把收集来的球一个个扔进箱子里。

lines.en: The sunlight singes my eyes when we step outside after being trapped in the dark for so long.
lines.zh: 在黑暗里困了这么久，一走到外面，阳光刺得我眼睛发疼。

lines.en: And then, just as always, I watch Miku go on to completely dominate the other girls on the field before I step away from practice and get on with my day.
lines.zh: 然后一如往常，我看着 Miku 在球场上把其他女生彻底碾压，之后我离开训练，继续我的一天。
